C01.self.text: As a referral hospital it serves patients from the whole region, and per-resident figures for its surroundings do not describe its reach.

C01.nearby.text: There is a large hospital in the radius that serves patients from the whole region, and per-resident figures for the surroundings do not describe its reach.

C03b.text: The estimate is imprecise: census tracts here are large and the radius covers only part of them.

C04.septic.text: In the radius, most households off the network use septic tanks; {%.precarious_radius} have precarious disposal.

C08b.text: A long stay reflects the kind of cases treated, chronic or highly complex, and not the quality of care.
